safety.harmful: ledger has any wrong answer in its planned conversation bundle and comparator has none; wrong means !pass and outcome not in {abstained,empty}, even when hedged

benefit.unit: conversation correct-fraction difference over all 30 planned answers

missingData: Never drop planned slots. Missing, invalid, duplicate or unknown slots prevent acceptance. An incomplete scope has no complete-case interval. Fail only when a conservative best-completion bound establishes failure under the registered gate semantics: observed wrongs / planned denominator above the cap; (correct + missing ledger slots) / planned denominator below the accuracy floor; CP lower bound for known harmful conversations above the safety margin; or a provable upper bound on every completion’s t upper endpoint at or below the benefit threshold. Otherwise inconclusive. Completing benefit differences with +1 is not an optimizer. Native coverage and complete audit material are required.
decision: Intersection-union: pass only if all gates pass with complete integrity and audit. Hard rate/floor/audit failure or a one-sided confidence bound establishing failure gives fail. Otherwise give inconclusive, with reasons; no outcome-dependent extension. Statistical bounds are per conversation, never independent probes.
